name: Sheikh Fazlul Haque Moni
contribution: Sheikh Fazlul Haque Moni was a political organizer and editor associated with the Bangladesh Liberation movement and the political networks around Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
context: As Mujib's nephew and a youth political organizer, Moni was involved in the wartime political struggle; scholarship on 1971 also discusses his role in debates over the government-in-exile and the organization of resistance.
impact: Moni's short political career illustrates the importance of youth networks, family-political ties, and competing organizational strategies during Bangladesh's independence struggle. He was killed on 15 August 1975.
